sentences.text: Shri Ravi Dwivedi, learned counsel for the appellant.

Shri Nitin Goyal, learned Public Prosecutor for the responden Heard on IA.No.10235/2023, 2nd applications u/Sec. 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant- Anand Kushwah.
Earlier application has been dismissed as withdrawn.

Vid e judgment dated 8.10.2021 passed in Spl. Case No.6/2020 by Additional Sessions Judge,
Lahar, Distt.Bhind, appellant has been convicted under Sections 450, 376, 305, 506 Part II of IPC and Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act with maximum sentence of ten years RI.
In brief case of the prosecution is that on 4.2.2018 Badshah informed police Station Daboh that prosecutrix aged about 15 years has committed suicide by hanging.
On his information, Meg No.2/2018 was recorded under Section 174 of Cr.P.C.
Dead-body Panchnama was prepared.
Dead-body was sent for postmortem.
As per postmortem report, cause of death is asphyxia due to hanging.
During Merg enquiry, it has come that brother of the prosecutrix seen the appellant and prosecutrix in compromising position.
On seeing brother of the prosecutrix, appellant ran away.
Prosecutrix then informed her brother that appellant has committed rape with her.
Thereafter crime was registered.
After investigation, charge-sheet was filed.
After trial, appellant has been convicted and sentenced as mentioned herein above.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that during trial he was on bail, but he did not misuse the liberty so granted.
During trial, he remained in custody for 239 days and thereafter from the date of judgment i.e. 8.10.2021 he is in custody.
Final hearing of the appeal will take time and he has a good case on merits.
Therefore, prayer for suspension of sentence has been made.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting upon merits of the case, IA.No.10235/2023 is allowed and it is directed that jail sentence of appellant Anand Kushwah Anand Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129235412/
1 will remain under suspension subject to verification that amount of fine has been deposited, on appellant's furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 18th December, 2023 and on such further dates as may be fixed by the office in this regard till disposal of the appeal.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE ms/-
